title: Circle Equation: Centre and Radius
body:
A circle has centre M(3, -2) and passes through the point P(7, 1).

a) Calculate the radius of the circle.
b) Write down the equation of the circle in the form $$(x-a)^2 + (y-b)^2 = r^2$$
